title: The Pharmaceutical CEO Who Pumped Placebos Into Cancer Patients
hook: A drug company CEO knowingly sold sugar pills to terminally ill cancer patients, pocketing millions while they died.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cancer patients being exploited resonates deeply, combining tragedy with corporate greed.

title: The Doctor Who Injected Radioactive Dye Into Healthy Brains
hook: A neurologist injected radioactive substances into healthy patients' brains without consent, just to observe the damage.
why_this_can_go_viral: Experiments on healthy brains invoke visceral fear of medical authority abuse.

title: The 'Cure' for Polio That Gave Children Paralysis
hook: A contaminated polio vaccine batch actually caused paralysis in thousands of children instead of preventing it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vaccine horror stories tap into deep-seated fears and historical mistrust.

title: The Skincare Giant That Hid Asbestos in Baby Powder for Decades
hook: A major company knew its talc-based baby powder contained asbestos but kept selling it, causing thousands of cancer deaths.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyday products linked to deadly diseases provoke widespread anger and concern.

title: The Government That Knew Leaded Gasoline Was Poisoning Everyone—Did Nothing
hook: For over 50 years, the government and oil companies suppressed evidence that leaded gasoline caused millions of brain-damaged children.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mass public health conspiracy with decades of evidence feels like a hidden history lesson.

title: The 'Antidepressant' That Made Patients Hallucinate and Attack Family
hook: A widely prescribed antidepressant caused violent psychotic episodes, leading to murders and suicides that the company tried to hide.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mental health medication causing extreme violence is a chilling and shareable revelation.

title: The Doctor Who Used Maggots to 'Clean' Wounds—Patients Died of Infection
hook: A surgeon used live maggots on post-surgical wounds claiming they were 'natural healers,' but patients died from septic shock.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gory, bizarre medical practice mixed with death creates a memorable, shareable shock factor.

title: The 'All-Natural' Herbal Remedy That Contained Arsenic and Lead
hook: A popular 'traditional' herbal supplement was found to contain toxic levels of arsenic and lead, causing organ failure in users.
why_this_can_go_viral: Natural products being deadly challenges common beliefs, driving debate and shares.

title: The Doctor Who Convinced Thousands They Had a Fake Disease—For Profit
hook: A physician created a fictional illness and convinced thousands of healthy people they had it, selling them expensive 'treatments.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Fabricated diseases exploit patient trust and resonate with fears of medical gaslighting.

title: The Government That Tested Syphilis on Prisoners—For 30 Years
hook: Prisoners were injected with syphilis without their knowledge, left untreated, and monitored as they went blind and insane.
why_this_can_go_viral: Systematic government abuse of vulnerable populations is a historically resonant, anger-driven topic.

title: The 'Safe' Topical Painkiller That Caused Third-Degree Burns
hook: An over-the-counter pain relief cream was found to cause severe chemical burns on skin, yet remained on shelves for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Common household products causing horrific injuries creates relatable fear and urgency.

title: The Supplement Company That Sold 'Vitamin C'—It Was Industrial Waste
hook: Factory waste contaminated with heavy metals was packaged and sold as Vitamin C supplements, causing heavy metal poisoning.
why_this_can_go_viral: Health products being toxic is a shocking irony that spreads easily.

title: The Doctor Who Operated on Patients While Drunk—For 15 Years
hook: A surgeon performed thousands of operations while intoxicated, causing countless deaths that were blamed on 'complications.'
why_this_can_go_viral: Immediate, visceral fear of being put under with a drunk doctor makes high-emotion content.

title: The 'Anti-Aging' Injection That Turned Women's Faces Into Stone
hook: An unapproved anti-aging injection caused permanent facial hardness and disfigurement, leaving women unable to smile or eat.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cosmetic procedures going horribly wrong is a high-interest, cautionary tale that drives shares.

title: The Government That Buried a Cancer Cluster in a Neighborhood—For 40 Years
hook: A government agency knew an entire neighborhood was sitting on a toxic chemical dump causing cancer, but hid the data for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: Environmental cover-ups resonate with widespread fear about hidden toxins in our communities.

title: The Doctor Who Used Patient Skin as Furniture Leather
hook: A pathologist removed skin from deceased patients and had it tanned into leather to make furniture and accessories.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme, grotesque violation of the dead triggers morbid curiosity and massive shareability.

title: The Government That Knew a Contagious Disease Was Airborne—But Called It 'Safe'
hook: Scientists warned that a dangerous respiratory disease was airborne, but the government downplayed it, leading to mass infection.
why_this_can_go_viral: Government mishandling of contagious diseases is a highly relevant and angering topic.
